title: Shop, Bone Boxes and cosmetics - House of Pips Wiki
description: The Supply Shop, Inventory, Bone Boxes and their odds, the Slap Track, and every kind of House of Pips cosmetic and how to earn it.
html:
Shop, Bone Boxes and cosmetics

Supply Shop #

The Supply Shop sells supplies for Bone Bucks. Each supply has a holding limit, and the shop won't sell you more than that. Four supplies are never sold: Blank Check, Rail Pass, Pip Eraser and Hammer Wax only come from Bone Boxes and the Slap Track. Every supply is described on the Supplies page.

Inventory #

The Inventory holds what you own:

  • Supplies. Table supplies are used from the match itself; XP and Bone Bucks boosts are activated here between matches.
  • Bone Boxes, ready to open.

You can sort the Inventory by ownership, value, rarity, name or count.

Bone Boxes #

A Bone Box is a sealed crate of random supplies. Buy one in the shop, earn one on the Slap Track, then open it from the Inventory. Each supply inside rolls its rarity using the odds printed on the box, then picks a supply of that rarity at random.

Plain Bone Box
180 Bone Bucks · 2 supplies inside · hold up to 3
Odds per supply: Common 58%, Uncommon 28%, Rare 11%, Epic 3%.
Carved Bone Box
390 Bone Bucks · 2 supplies inside · hold up to 3
Odds per supply: Common 12%, Uncommon 34%, Rare 34%, Epic 20%.
Gilded Bone Box
690 Bone Bucks · 3 supplies inside · hold up to 3
Odds per supply: Uncommon 8%, Rare 30%, Epic 62%. The first supply is always Epic or better.

If a supply would take you over its holding limit, you get a Bone Bucks refund instead of the item: part of the box's price, and more for rarer items.

The Slap Track #

The Slap Track has one reward for each career level, up to level 30: supplies, Bone Boxes and cosmetics. Claim them in order from the Slap Track screen.

  • A supply or Bone Box you can't hold any more pays its full Bone Bucks price instead.
  • A cosmetic you already own is replaced by a Dealer's Dare.
  • After a Prestige the track starts again: levels 10 and 30 give a free skill respec, and the cosmetic levels hold new cosmetics.

Cosmetics #

Cosmetics change how the game looks and sounds. They never affect play. Choose them from Cosmetics on the main menu.

  • Table skins the background felt behind the table. Classic Felt is the default; more come from the Slap Track.
  • Domino skins the design on the back of every bone.
    • Plain Ivory is the default.
    • The Alpha, Three Decades, Cyberpunk Circuit and Steampunk Gear come from the Slap Track.
    • Arcane Magic, Skull and Crossbones, Galaxy and Jigsaw are the rewards for the four puzzle sets. See Puzzles.
    • Seasonal skins unlock for good when you open the game in their month: Valentine Heart in February, Halloween Night in October and Silver and Gold in December.
    • Pride skins come from the Slap Track after Prestige.
    • The Country Flag collection is a separate add-on.
  • Background music songs for the table. The House Theme is the default; more songs come from the Slap Track and Prestige. Settings has a shuffle option.
  • Avatars your player portrait, chosen from Choose your avatar on the main menu. More portraits come from the Slap Track, puzzle sets and online play.

Online play has its own cosmetic rewards: tile backs, edge finishes, placement effects and badges. See Online play.
